envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in Step 1 of every test case
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login Step 2
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login Step 4
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME_DISPLAY_ONLY: Add to .env — a SAP user with display-only PO access (no Change authorization) — required by TC-CS-016 (currently BLOCKED)
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD_DISPLAY_ONLY: Add to .env — password for the display-only user above — required by TC-CS-016 (currently BLOCKED)

TD-CS-003-001.name: Existing Valid Purchase Order — Display Mode View
TD-CS-003-001.executionNote: IMPORTANT: In this SAP tenant, 'Manage Purchase Orders' app opens PO DIRECTLY in edit/draft mode — there is no display-only mode accessible from the list page. TC-CS-012 result was FAIL due to this app behavior.
TD-CS-003-001.expectedOutcome: PO opens; all header and line item details visible — NOTE: fields are editable (not read-only) in this app

TD-CS-003-002.name: Existing Valid Purchase Order — Edit Mode Quantity Change
TD-CS-003-002.expectedOutcome: PO opened in edit mode; quantity updated to 15; Net Order Value updated to 1.20 USD; PO saved via Order button; returns to list

TD-CS-003-NEG-001.name: Non-existent PO Number — Valid Format
TD-CS-003-NEG-001.executionNote: Confirmed: 9999999999 returns 'No data found. Try adjusting the search or filter criteria.' — previously tried 4500000001 which EXISTS in this SAP system.
TD-CS-003-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: SAP list shows 'No data found. Try adjusting the search or filter criteria.'; no PO detail opened

TD-CS-003-NEG-002.name: Existing PO — Display Mode Read-Only Enforcement
TD-CS-003-NEG-002.executionNote: TC-CS-015 FAIL: PO opens in edit mode directly; all fields ARE editable. AC-4 (read-only in display mode) cannot be verified with current app behavior.
TD-CS-003-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: REVISED: PO fields are editable (app opens in edit mode). Test expected read-only but actual app behavior is edit mode. Requires URL-level display navigation to test AC-4.

TD-CS-003-NEG-003.name: Existing PO — Unauthorized Edit Attempt by Display-Only User
TD-CS-003-NEG-003.note: TC-CS-016 BLOCKED: Requires ENV.SAP_USERNAME_DISPLAY_ONLY and ENV.SAP_PASSWORD_DISPLAY_ONLY in .env. Not yet configured.
TD-CS-003-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: Edit button absent or disabled for display-only user; PO cannot be switched to edit mode

TD-CS-003-ERR-001.name: Purchase Order with Goods-Receipted Line Item
TD-CS-003-ERR-001.note: TC-CS-017 BLOCKED: grPoNumber not resolved. Requires manual SAP setup — post a GR against a test PO, then update this value. PO 4500000001 (from 2020, status 'Follow-On Documents') is a candidate but not verified for GR line lock.
TD-CS-003-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: In edit mode, quantity field on GR-posted line item is locked; SAP shows explanation tooltip/message

TD-CS-003-EDGE-001.name: Minimum Valid Quantity Boundary (Lower Boundary = 1)
TD-CS-003-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Quantity of 1 accepted; PO saved; Net Order Value = 0.08 USD (1 KG × 0.08 USD/KG)

TD-CS-003-EDGE-002.name: Zero Quantity — Invalid Boundary (Zero = 0)
TD-CS-003-EDGE-002.executionNote: Confirmed: SAP rejects 0 with message 'Enter PO Quantity' (shown in Messages dialog for Item 00010). PO stays on edit page (does not navigate to list).
TD-CS-003-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: SAP displays 'Enter PO Quantity' in Messages dialog; Order button click keeps PO on edit page; save blocked

TD-CS-003-EDGE-003.name: Invalid PO Number Format (Non-numeric or Too Short)
TD-CS-003-EDGE-003.executionNote: Confirmed: 'INVALID123' in PO filter returns 'No data found. Try adjusting the search or filter criteria.' — same message as non-existent numeric PO. No explicit format error.
TD-CS-003-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: SAP list shows 'No data found. Try adjusting the search or filter criteria.'; system stable; no PO opened
